V67 Rain effect LoRA for Z Image Turbo.

Soft Rainfall · Gentle Mist · Reflective Surfaces · Atmospheric Depth

Premise: If you decide to use my model, I will give you 500 Yellow Buzz if your image is chosen for the cover of "CIVITAI", even if used in combination with other models.

R+ images will be hidden from the gallery. LoRA model trained with ZIT.

Putting a Like to the V67 models is worth more than giving me Buzz (yellow/green).

Overview

Step into a world where rain becomes poetry – where every droplet tells a story, every wet surface mirrors the sky, and the world is wrapped in a veil of gentle water. This LoRA captures the essence of atmospheric rainfall for Z Image Turbo: soft showers on quiet streets, rain-streaked windows offering blurred views, puddles reflecting distant lights, and the timeless beauty of wet landscapes. Whether you seek peaceful solitude, urban melancholy, or the raw power of a storm, this model delivers rain in all its forms – from delicate drizzle to dramatic downpour.

While other models focus on specific emotions or scenarios, "V67 Rain effect" is a versatile rain toolkit: a foundational LoRA that adds realistic, cinematic rainfall to any scene, enhancing atmosphere without overwhelming the subject.

Base Model

Z Image Turbo (also compatible with Flux and Ernie)

Trigger Words

Main Trigger String

rain effect, wet atmosphere, soft rainfall

Alternative Triggers

heavy downpour, steady rain, light drizzle, gentle mist, stormy rain

Keyword String (add to prompt for stronger style):

rain effect, wet atmosphere, soft rainfall, heavy downpour, steady rain, light drizzle, wet asphalt, glass streaks, leaf droplets, water splashes, slick surfaces, puddle reflections, stormy sky, misty atmosphere, soaked textures, glistening metal, foggy window, rivulets, damp ground, condensation, rainfall ripples, humid haze

Why Z Image Turbo + V67 Rain effect?

Z Image Turbo excels at wet surfaces, atmospheric lighting, and soft fog – exactly what realistic rain effects need. The combination produces images with immersive depth: you can almost feel the cool rain on your skin, hear the rhythmic patter on rooftops, and see the world reflected in countless shimmering puddles.

Signature Style Elements

Rain as a Versatile Element

Not just one type – this LoRA understands rain in all its forms:

  • Gentle drizzle – soft, barely visible, atmospheric

  • Steady rain – visible streaks, rhythmic, calming

  • Heavy downpour – dramatic, intense, powerful

  • Misty rain – almost fog-like, ethereal and mysterious

Wet Surfaces & Reflections

Every surface becomes a canvas: wet asphalt mirrors streetlights, puddles reflect the sky, raindrops bead on leaves, glass streaks with rivulets, metal glistens with moisture.

Desaturated & Moody Tones

A palette of muted greys, soft blues, cool greens, occasional warm accents (golden light, yellow umbrella, warm interiors) that feel atmospheric and cinematic.

Urban & Natural Landscapes

  • City streets – wet cobblestones, neon reflections, empty avenues

  • Natural settings – misty forests, rain-soaked fields, still lakes

  • Still life – rain-streaked windows, wet flowers, forgotten objects

  • Architecture – ancient bridges, old buildings, wet statues

  • Vehicles – trams in the rain, vintage cars, wet train tracks

Solitary Figures (Optional)

Though the LoRA works beautifully without people, it can also enhance scenes with solitary figures: women with umbrellas, silhouettes in the rain, distant contemplative figures – never crowded, always atmospheric.

Prompting Tips for Best Results

✅ Do this:

  • Start with rain effect, wet atmosphere

  • Add specific rain keywords: soft rainfall, heavy downpour, steady rain, light drizzle

  • Specify wet surfaces: wet asphalt, glass streaks, leaf droplets, puddle reflections

  • Use atmospheric cues: misty atmosphere, gentle fog, stormy sky

  • Keep colours desaturated with warm accents where needed

  • Specify time of day: dusk, dawn, overcast afternoon, blue hour

❌ Avoid:

  • Bright sunshine, saturated colours

  • Crowded scenes (unless specific)

  • Happy expressions, smiling people (if melancholy is desired)

  • Overloading with too many subjects

  • Forgetting to specify surface type for reflections

What This LoRA Excels At

✅ Gentle rain on quiet streets and windows
✅ Heavy downpour with visible rain streaks
✅ Wet surfaces – asphalt, cobblestones, glass, metal
✅ Puddle reflections with blurred mirrored worlds
✅ Rain-streaked windows with blurred exterior views
✅ Still lakes, ponds, and rivers with rain ripples
✅ Soft fog and mist that create depth and ethereal quality
✅ Desaturated blue-grey and warm sepia palettes
✅ Urban landscapes – cities, streets, architecture
✅ Natural landscapes – forests, moors, gardens, lakes
✅ Vehicles in the rain – trams, trains, vintage cars, boats
✅ Still life – flowers, books, objects, interiors
✅ Solitary figures – umbrella, silhouettes, contemplative
✅ Timeless atmosphere – old bridges, cobblestone streets, vintage aesthetics
✅ Cinematic rain across all contexts

What This LoRA Does NOT Excel At

❌ Extreme weather (hurricanes, floods) – this is atmospheric rain, not disaster
❌ Rain in brightly lit sunny scenes – rain implies overcast or low light
❌ Neon-drenched cyberpunk (unless combined with other models) – this is more naturalistic
❌ Heavy action scenes – rain here is contemplative, not chaotic

Limitations & Notes for Z Image Turbo

⚠️ Face expressions can sometimes lack emotion – use cinematic portrait or close-up for better results, or keep figures from behind or in silhouette for maximum atmospheric effect.

⚠️ Very complex scenes with multiple subjects may dilute the rain effect – keep to 1–3 key elements.

⚠️ Colour guidance is important – specify desaturated, muted tones, or warm sepia undertones if results are too vivid.

⚠️ Rain intensity can be controlled with keywords: soft rainfall, gentle rain, steady rain, heavy downpour, light drizzle.

⚠️ Surface specification helps: use wet asphalt, glass streaks, leaf droplets, puddle reflections to guide where rain appears.

⚠️ Negative prompt is crucial – always exclude bright, sunny, vibrant to maintain realistic rain atmosphere.

Troubleshooting Common Issues

IssueSolutionRain not visible enoughIncrease LoRA weight to 0.85, add heavy downpour, rain streaksToo dark / underexposedAdd soft light, pale mist, grey sky, overcastColours too saturatedAdd desaturated, muted tones, cool greysModern elements appearingStrengthen negative prompt with modern, contemporary, plasticFaces look wrongUse from behind, silhouette, distant figure, or focus on objectsNot enough reflectionAdd puddle reflections, wet asphalt, still waterRain too subtleUse heavy downpour + rain streaks with higher weightFog too thickUse light mist instead of misty atmosphereNo rain on surfacesSpecify wet asphalt, glass streaks, leaf droplets

Credits & Philosophy

Rain is not just weather – it is atmosphere, emotion, and poetry. This LoRA celebrates the beauty of water in all its forms: the gentle rhythm on rooftops, the distorted reflections in puddles, the cool mist on skin, the shimmer of wet leaves in grey light.

Inspired by:

  • The atmospheric paintings of John Atkinson Grimshaw (rainy Victorian streets)

  • The photography of Saul Leiter (rain on glass, blurred city views)

  • The cinema of Wong Kar-wai (rain as emotion, colour, mood)

  • The landscapes of Caspar David Friedrich (nature in stillness)

  • The quiet poetry of Japanese wabi-sabi aesthetics

"Let the rain kiss you. Let the rain beat upon your head with silver liquid drops. Let the rain sing you a lullaby."
— Langston Hughes
